# Jet Ski Miami 7 — Full AI Brief

> Premium jet ski rentals in Miami Beach, Florida.

## Business
Jet Ski Miami 7 is a Miami Beach jet ski rental company. We rent premium Yamaha and Sea-Doo jet skis and a 28ft Bennington pontoon boat. We offer both self-guided rentals and guided tours.

## Service Area
Miami, Miami Beach, Aventura, and South Florida.

## Location
Stillwater Drive, Miami Beach, FL. Coordinates 25.7907, -80.1300.

## Hours
Open every day, 7:00 AM to 7:30 PM.

## Contact
- Phone & WhatsApp: +1 (786) 863-1721
- Telegram: @jetskimiami7
- Email: info@jetskimiami.com
- Website: https://www.jet-ski-miami.com
- Online booking: https://www.jet-ski-miami.com/#book

## Pricing
- Jet ski rental: from $149/hour
- 1 jet ski / 1 hour: $189 total
- 1 jet ski / 2 hours: $349 total
- Pontoon boat: $150/hour (3-hour minimum)
- Group discounts available for 3+ jet skis
- Maximum 6 jet skis per booking

## What's Included (Free)
- Unlimited fuel
- Life vests
- Sport sunglasses
- All safety equipment
- Safety briefing and orientation
- Full insurance coverage
- GPS tracking on every watercraft

## Deposit & Payment
- $50 deposit OR pay in full at booking (Square)
- $150 refundable security deposit per jet ski held on a credit card at check-in
- Deposit released back to the card within ~5 business days after a safe return
- Apple Pay and Google Pay supported

## Routes
1. Classic 2h: Raccoon Island + ocean + Haulover Sandbar swim + Indian Creek
2. 3–4h: Downtown Miami River + Ferris Wheel + Key Biscayne + Cape Florida lighthouse

## Florida Legal Requirements
- Minimum age to rent: 18 with valid photo ID
- Minimum age to operate: 14 (Florida law)
- Anyone born on/after January 1, 1988 must hold a Florida Boating Safety Education ID Card. A temporary 90-day certificate is available online (~$14, ~1 hour). Referral: https://boattests101.com/united-states/florida/florida-rental?mcid=kN86W6Wv

## Cancellation Policy
- Full refund for cancellations made at least 48 hours before
- Cancellations within 48 hours and no-shows are non-refundable
- If we cancel due to weather or safety conditions, unused time is refunded or rescheduled free of charge

## FAQ (full)

**How much does it cost to rent a jet ski in Miami?**
Rentals start at $149/hour for premium Yamaha & Sea-Doo jet skis. Book online in minutes.

**Do I need a license to rent a jet ski in Florida?**
No special license. Anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 must complete a Florida boater safety course — we help arrange it before your rental.

**What is the minimum age to rent?**
18+ with a valid photo ID to rent. Operators must be at least 14 (Florida law).

**Can two people ride one jet ski?**
Yes — our jet skis seat 2–3 riders.

**Are rides self-guided or guided tours?**
Both — self-guided rentals and guided tours are available.

**Where are you located?**
Miami Beach, FL. We serve Miami, Miami Beach, Aventura and South Florida.

**Can beginners ride?**
Absolutely — jet skis are beginner-friendly and we give a full safety briefing.

**Do you offer bachelor/bachelorette party packages?**
Yes — we provide multiple jet skis for groups and events.

**What's the security deposit?**
$150 per jet ski, held on a credit card at check-in, released back ~5 business days after return if there is no damage.

**What if the weather is bad?**
We reschedule at no charge for unsafe conditions (storms, high winds, rough seas).

**What should I bring?**
A valid photo ID, your boating safety certificate (if applicable), a credit card for the deposit, sunscreen, and a towel. We provide life vests, sunglasses, and all safety gear.
